observation_summary: The compiler failed to report a type mismatch warning when a class implemented an interface but assigned a property in its constructor with a type incompatible with the interface definition.
reasoning_summary: The bug was caused by the type checker failing to validate property types when a class implements an interface. While the compiler checked if a property existed on the implementation, it did not verify that the property's type matched the interface's definition when the property was defined inside the constructor (as opposed to the prototype). The fix involved moving the type mismatch validation logic into the TypeValidator, ensuring that property assignments in constructors are correctly checked against interface requirements.
